LanguageData.QFW_Rec4: Pipette, copy settings, haul now, zone ±, QoL window
LanguageData.QFW_WorkSpeed_Desc: Multiplies the work speed of each kind of work by its slider below.
LanguageData.QFW_ColonistsOnly_Desc: On: only pawns of your colony (colonists, slaves, mechanoids) work faster. Off: everyone, also visitors and raiders.
LanguageData.QFW_SpCraft_Desc: Crafting, smithing, tailoring, art, drug making and other workbench work.
LanguageData.QFW_SpPlants_Desc: Sowing, harvesting, cutting plants and felling trees.
LanguageData.QFW_SpMedical_Desc: Tending and surgery speed (not the success chance).
LanguageData.QFW_Prisoners_Desc: Faster recruiting and enslaving, and the unwavering loyalty setting below.
LanguageData.QFW_RecruitMult_Desc: Each recruitment talk lowers resistance this many times more.
LanguageData.QFW_EnslaveMult_Desc: Each enslavement talk lowers will this many times more.
LanguageData.QFW_Unwavering_Desc: Some prisoners can never be recruited (unwavering loyalty). Here you can keep it, remove it after some days in prison, or remove it right away.
LanguageData.QFW_UnwDays_Desc: After this many days in your prison the loyalty breaks and the prisoner can be recruited.
LanguageData.QFW_NowRecruitable: {0} is not unwavering any more – can be recruited now.
LanguageData.QFW_Pipette_Desc: Press the key and click anything on the map: you get it in hand to build (same building, material, style and rotation). Floors give the floor, items offer a bill at a workbench.
LanguageData.QFW_PipetteInstant_Desc: The key picks what is under the mouse at once, without the extra click.
LanguageData.QFW_PipetteKey: Key: {0} (change it in Options → Keyboard, section "QoL – Faster Work").
LanguageData.QFW_PipNothing: Nothing there that can be built.
LanguageData.QFW_PipLocked: {0} isn't available yet (research or another requirement missing).
LanguageData.QFW_CopyPawn_Desc: Buttons on a colonist: copy work priorities, schedule, policies, medical care, response to hostiles and allowed area, and paste them to other colonists.
LanguageData.QFW_CopyPawn_BtnDesc: Remember this colonist's work priorities, schedule, policies, medical care, response to hostiles and allowed area.
LanguageData.QFW_PastePawn_BtnDesc: Give the selected colonists the settings copied from {0} – all, or only a part.
LanguageData.QFW_PastePolicies: Only policies, medical care and response to hostiles
LanguageData.QFW_HaulNow_Desc: Button on items: the selected items go to storage right away, carried by the nearest free colonists.
LanguageData.QFW_HaulNow_BtnDesc: The nearest free colonists carry the selected items to storage right away.
LanguageData.QFW_HaulNoPawn: No free colonist who can haul.
LanguageData.QFW_HaulNoStore: {0} item(s) have no reachable storage that accepts them.
LanguageData.QFW_ZoneTools_Desc: Buttons on stockpile and growing zones: make the zone one cell bigger or smaller on every side.
LanguageData.QFW_ZoneGrow_Desc: Adds one cell on every side, where the zone can go.
LanguageData.QFW_ZoneShrink_Desc: Removes the outer ring of cells.
LanguageData.QFW_ZoneTooSmall: The zone is too small to shrink.
LanguageData.QFW_ColonyTab: QoL button in the bottom bar
LanguageData.QFW_ColonyTab_Desc: Map search, prisoner overview and colony actions (everyone eat / sleep / wake up).
LanguageData.QFW_Stacks_Desc: Multiplies how many items fit in one stack. Takes effect after a restart. If you turn it off later, oversized stacks may split or show errors once.
LanguageData.QFW_StackMult_Desc: Multiplier of every item's stack limit.
LanguageData.QFW_StacksRestart: Restart the game to apply the new stack size.
LanguageData.QFW_StacksOgre: OgreStack is active – use only one of them for stack sizes.
LanguageData.QFW_Notifications_Desc: Make letters and messages of a chosen kind silent, or hide them.
LanguageData.QFW_NotifyNote: Silent = comes without sound. Hidden = doesn't pop up at all, but still goes to History (Menu → History → Messages). Careful with threat letters. These choices are not part of the recommended settings.
LanguageData.QFW_SlaveRecruit_Desc: A slave who is not unwavering (or whose loyalty has broken) can be made a free colonist from the QoL window – also slaves taken from other factions.
LanguageData.QFW_DeconAll_Desc: Ancient walls, ruins, wrecks and other things the game only lets you destroy by attacking can be deconstructed. Buildings of hostile factions are not included.
LanguageData.QFW_MakeColonist_Desc: The slave becomes a free colonist of your colony (remembers being enslaved for a while).
LanguageData.QFW_SearchHint: Items, buildings, pawns and plants on this map. Accents and dashes don't matter.
LanguageData.QFW_SearchType: Type at least two letters, e.g. "steel".
LanguageData.QFW_NoPrisoners: No prisoners or slaves on this map.
LanguageData.QFW_AllEat_Desc: Free colonists who are below 80 % food go eat now (e.g. before a long trip or a raid).
LanguageData.QFW_AllEat_Done: {0} colonist(s) go eat, {1} not hungry or no food.
LanguageData.QFW_AllSleep_Desc: Free colonists who are below 90 % rest go to bed now.
LanguageData.QFW_AllSleep_Done: {0} colonist(s) go to sleep, {1} rested or already sleeping.
LanguageData.QFW_AllWake_Desc: Sleeping colonists get up (not the sick or wounded who need bed rest).
LanguageData.QFW_PipetteBtn_Desc: Click anything on the map to build the same. Faster with the key.
LanguageData.MUI_DescOn: The mod sets itself up and works right away. Ideal for new players and anyone who does not want to tweak anything.
LanguageData.MUI_DescOffSame: Custom settings. Still the same as recommended.
LanguageData.MUI_ConfirmOn: Turn recommended settings on? Your changes ({0}) will be replaced with the recommended values.
LanguageData.MUI_Locked: Detailed settings are locked. Want to change them? Turn off the switch above – your values start from the recommended ones.
LanguageData.MUI_ChangedTip: Differs from the recommended setting ({0}). Click to restore the recommended value.
